name: Sobha Aranya
summary: Project, developer, Karma Lakelands Sector 80 location, RERA number, starting price, unit sizes and 5 towers / 524 units are confirmed. Possession is disputed: some sources cite December 2028 per HRERA, while Square Yards and others give December 2030. The 31.28-acre land area is quoted by some sources, but Square Yards and others give 14.81 acres (phase 1).
